name: oidc-sso
description: Generic OpenID Connect single sign-on: configure any standards-compliant identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia, Google, Microsoft Entra, Okta) and let users sign in with it.
author: Catalyst Team

permissionDescriptions.routes.public: Serves the SSO authorize/callback endpoints and the provider picker without a panel session — required for the login redirect flow.
permissionDescriptions.auth.sessions: Signs you in by creating a panel session cookie after the identity provider authenticates you.
permissionDescriptions.auth.users: Looks up panel users by SSO email and creates panel accounts for first-time SSO sign-ins (when enabled).
permissionDescriptions.roles.assign: Applies configured default panel roles to accounts created via SSO.
permissionDescriptions.user.read: Counts existing users so the first panel account can never be created via SSO (setup wizard stays authoritative).

oidc:user_signed_in.description: A user completed OIDC sign-in (session created).

oidc:account_linked.description: An OIDC identity was linked to a panel user (register, email match, or manual link).

oidc:account_unlinked.description: An OIDC identity was unlinked from a panel user.
